newsitem.title: JAPAN: Peru foreign minister one of hostages--Japan.
newsitem.headline: Peru foreign minister one of hostages--Japan.

text.p: Peruvian Foreign Minister Francisco Tudela was among the people taken hostage by a band of armed guerrillas at the residence of the Japanese ambassador to Peru, a Japanese Foreign Ministry official said on Wednesday.
The official said women were being freed by the guerrillas but could not say exactly how many people were inside the compound when the attack occurred.
The mother of Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori was among those freed, the official told a news briefing.
The attack by leftist guerrillas armed with automatic weapons occurred on Tuesday during a reception hosted by Japanese Ambassador Morihisa Aoki for Emperor Akihito's birthday.
The Foreign Ministry, however, was not in contact with Ambassador Aoki, the official said.
